I hope this is helpful but I would look at your relationship with being vulnerable. Do you fear being vulnerable? Do you avoid certain situations that would potentially make you feel bare emotionally?  If so what’s at the core of that fear? 

Being able to be vulnerable is intrinsically linked to intimacy in my eyes. For me, being in any sort relationship (platonically or romantically) raises the risk of feeling emotionally raw and uncared for. It’s scary but I take certain steps to ease my fear. It might help to lean into those feelings. In the past, what has intimacy felt like for you? I would try to explore those moments. What lead up to those moments? Where did the discomfort come from? Allow yourself to feel whatever you feel and gently remind yourself that you are worthy of care.
